text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here. 8.Photocopy of awards certificate If applicable
